description: The builder's decision to push a commit without a passing pass_record. Written only on the builder's instruction.

reason.description: Why the pipeline is being bypassed: at least 20 characters, so a bare 'skip' does not pass.

at.description: When the override was given, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC.

stages_skipped.description: The ids of the stages that did not run or did not pass.
